opinions.text: Motion of New York for judgment of the pleadings against Texas referred to the Special Master. Motions of Idaho, Arizona, and Alabama et al. for leave to file complaints in intervention referred to the Special Master. Motions of Connecticut, New Mexico, Tennessee, Wisconsin, Virginia, and District of Columbia for leave to intervene referred to the Special Master. [For earlier order herein, see, e. g., 489 U. S. 1005.]
